title: Momentum
description: How the price has moved over the last ten and thirty seconds. Short bursts of momentum are what a two-minute round trades on.

return_bps_10s.label: Return 10s
return_bps_10s.description: The change in midpoint over the last ten seconds, in basis points. Positive means the price has been rising.

return_bps_30s.label: Return 30s
return_bps_30s.description: The change in midpoint over the last thirty seconds, in basis points. Compare it with the ten-second read to see if a move is accelerating.

direction_10s.label: Move direction 10s
direction_10s.description: Up or down once the ten-second return clears a small threshold, otherwise flat. The one-word version of the return.
